verdict.rationale: gstack keeps cross-session learnings locally in ~/.gstack/projects/{slug}/learnings.jsonl, and the /learn skill lets users review, search, prune, and export them, which gives real deletion control over that store. A community reply also notes that usage telemetry can be opted out of. Missing for 10: a documented retention policy or retention settings, deletion controls for per-site domain skills and telemetry data already collected, first-party docs on telemetry opt-out, and independent hands-on corroboration.
